description: Find the customs code for a product: 10-digit HTS codes for goods imported into the US, or Schedule B codes for US exports (origin US). Search by short keywords as the official tariff wording uses them (e.g. 'chairs', 'seats', 'cotton t-shirts', 'bolts'), not marketing names; one or two words work best, and a code prefix (e.g. '9401') lists the codes under it. Show the user the matches and let them pick; the code they ship under is their call. Free, no account needed.

origin.description: ISO alpha-2 country the freight ships FROM: 'US' for an export (Schedule B), the supplier's country for an import (HTS)

query.description: Product keywords or the start of a code

name: hs_code_search
title: Customs Code Search (HTS / Schedule B)
